mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals a strong accommodative monetary policy stance, leading to increased liquidity in the market and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE increases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of sustained RSAFS growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% year-over-year signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO decreases by more than 2% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 8% and the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1%, the combination signals a weak economy with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE > 8% and FEDFUNDS < 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 10% month-over-month signals a surge in demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when HOUST increases by more than 10% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 2% signals inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates tighter monetary policy.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL increases by more than 2% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points in the same month, it signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when PAYEMS > 200k and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2pp in the same month.
